eos_records.label: Grzechnik and Friese (2010)
eos_records.notes: Knorr et al. report K0 = 51(1) GPa and K0' = 4.3(9) for B1 PbS. Grzechnik and Friese independently measured ambient V0 = 209.2(1) A^3 and reproduce those coefficients; their structure paper remains the source for the stored phase metadata. The imported generic thermal coefficient was removed.
